03-14-1110 is March 14, 1110.  
Subtract 356 days:  
1110 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
From March 14 back 356 days: go back 365 days to March 15, 1109, then add 9 days forward → March 24, 1109.  
Check: 356 days = 365 - 9, so March 14, 1110 minus 365 days = March 15, 1109, plus 9 days = March 24, 1109.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1109-03-24
